title: What I'm thankful for: six waiver adds that carried me to the ship
parts:
🦃 WHAT I'M THANKFUL FOR

Six guys I picked up off waivers this season. All six helped carry me to the championship.

FP/G and position ranks: Fantrax, thru Week 12, FBS players with 6+ games. Board ranks (#): Alpha Draft Signal, thru Wk 11.

👇

🏃 Cole Tabb, RB, Cincinnati

RB5 at 26.3 FP/G. 54.0 vs Colorado, the top line of Week 12.

His carry share: 29% on the season, 38% over his last 4. He's 86% rostered on Fantrax now.

🙌 Jesse Legree, WR, Oregon State (FR)

Preseason WR #1,029 on the Alpha Draft Signal, now #19.

WR4 at 28.1 FP/G. 1,418 yds, 15 TD, 35% of the Beavers' rec yds. Best: 47.1 vs SDSU.

🎯 Marcus Stokes, QB, Memphis

Preseason QB #597, now #54.

QB11 at 30.7 FP/G. 3,047 pass yds, 28 TD, 7 INT, 10.2 adjusted yds per attempt. Best: 49.8 at Charlotte.

🏃 Aiden Flora, RB, Iowa State

Preseason RB #751, now #83.

RB4 at 26.9 FP/G. 1,506 rush yds, 14 TD, 7.2 per carry.
Last 4: 64% of ISU's carries, 36.7 FP/G.

🧱 Jelani Thurman, TE, North Carolina

Preseason TE #48, now #6.

TE6 at 18.0 FP/G. 51 rec, 610 yds, 8 TD, 23% of UNC's rec yds. Best: 30.7 vs UConn.

🙌 Reed Harris, WR, Arizona State
WR7 at 23.0 FP/G. 70 rec, 1,159 yds, 11 TD. Week 12: 11-172-2.

Six waiver adds. One title shot.

The wire wins more leagues than draft day does. Keep checking it.

Happy Thanksgiving. Who's the pickup you're thankful for? 👇
